title: CPI Offers an Unpleasant Surprise
summary: Traders were poised to react to the September CPI report that arrived at 8:30 ET today. Most were disappointed. The Core index rose by 0.3% during the month, in-line with August’s 0.3% rise but above the 0.2% consensus estimate. Put simply, people were disappointed to see no progress on inflation when some was expected – especially when the headline reading rose by an as-expected 0.6% this month, above last month’s 0.4%. Hopes for a “one and done” set of rate hikes that arose yesterday were quashed.
